items.title: React for Agents: Astro Creator Brings Hooks to his Meta-Harness, Flue
items.summary: Flue 2 takes its inspiration from React. Creator Fred Schott, of Astro fame, tells Latent Space why he added hooks and why agents are defined by their harnesses.

items.title: CORS Chat
items.summary:
Tool: CORS Chat
        I built this today (with GPT-5.6-Sol xhigh) to help test Qwen 3.8 27B running in LM Studio on both my M5 MacBook Pro and an NVIDIA DGX Spark.
It provides a web UI for exercising an OpenAI-Responses-compatible chat endpoint. I've tried it against LM Studio with the --cors option and OpenRouter, and both work fine.

items.title: Northern Gannet
items.summary:
Northern Gannet, in Pillar Point Harbor, CA, USThis is Morris.
Morris is a local celebrity: the only known Northern Gannet (Morus bassanus) in the entire Pacific Ocean.
They showed up in the Farallon Islands off the coast of San Francisco 14 years ago. They have since made Pillar Point harbor their home, where they are quite easy to spot: the only white bird with a yellow head, usually hanging out with the smaller black Brandt’s cormorants near the harbor sign visible from the end of the commerc
